cohort: 20 women with sPTD (gestation ≤34 weeks) and 20 term control women (gestation ≥39 weeks) matched for age (±5 years), parity, ethnicity, and route of delivery
finding: Women with sPTD had significantly lower augmentation index-75 and central pulse pressure, but no difference in pulse wave velocity compared to controls, and also had significantly lower high-density lipoprotein cholesterol.
gest_age: ≤34 weeks for sPTD group, ≥39 weeks for term control group
